text:
infra-bot: nightly-alert: perf dashboard detected a regression on prefetched KV paths. p50 +12%, p95 +22% vs baseline (last successful nightly). Metric: runtime.kv.prefetch.latency. link: https://dash.redwood/internal/nightly/perf/305000
camille: ugh, that correlates with the kernel-selection merge that went out ~01:10 UTC (PR #6248). :thinking:
aj: saw the same in my local smoke, p95 spikes when cache-hotset churns. I think the selector prefers bigger kernels now and that hurts prefetch locality.
mayank: can you paste the commit hash? I'll run a quick bisect.
aj: merge commit abcdef1234 (merge: feature/kernel-selection-v2)
camille: CI nightly job `ci/perf/nightly_kv_latency` failed too, looks like a 20% regression on the canary pool.
sre-bot: Canary rollout paused: canary group 3/8 failed SLO check (latency). See incident link: https://incident.redwood/INC-3050 :eyes:
aj: quick profiling dump from a failing canary attached:
```
perf top -p 12345
  18.4%  runtime  [.] kernel_selector::choose
  12.2%  runtime  [.] kv::prefetch::dispatch
  9.1%   runtime  [.] batcher::merge_requests
  6.5%   runtime  [.] cache::evict
```
cheng: flamegraph from canary attached: https://prof.redwood/graphs/305000-kv-flame. Kernel selector now has deeper callstack and more time in heuristics.
mayank: running `git bisect start origin/main abcdef1234 -- perf/nightly_kv_latency` now, will report first bad commit.
camille: suggestion: if selector is preferring larger kernels it might increase KV working set per call causing more evictions -> prefetch miss thrash.
aj: confirmed locally: toggling `selector.prefer_large_kernels = false` recovers baseline numbers.
mayank: bisect points to 9f7b2e6 (selector: weight update + lookahead heuristic). Adding that as suspect.
camille: propose hotfix: revert 9f7b2e6 in canary and re-run nightly. If green, roll out full revert and open follow-up with improved test coverage.
sre-bot: rollback job queued: `deploy rollback --app runtime --to-revision 9f7b2e6^` (ETA ~7m)
aj: also adding new unit test to `selector_tests.rs` that simulates KV-prefetch hotset and verifies kernel choice distribution.
cheng: will add a perf-e2e job that runs synthetic hotset for 10k requests to catch this in CI nightly.
mayank: bisect log: first-bad: 9f7b2e6, good: 3b4c1d0. Pushing revert PR now.
camille: thanks everyone. action items: (1) revert PR into canary (mayank) (2) add perf-e2e and selector unit tests (cheng/aj) (3) monitor nightly dashboard next run and unpause rollout if stable (sre)
aj: quick note — add a `prefetch_hotset_simulation` harness parameter to CI so we don't regress this silently again.
camille: ack. leaving this thread open until next nightly completes. :thumbsup:
